items.title: Tesla to launch Cybercab in Austin this month - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- Tesla Inc. has informed staff it is preparing for a public launch of the Cybercab, its first vehicle built without a steering wheel or brake pedal, in Austin, Texas, as soon as this month, The Information reported on Monday.

items.title: Here’s How Nancy Pelosi Beat the Stock Market and Warren Buffett
items.summary: The S&P 500 has delivered roughly 13% annualized returns over the past decade, one of the strongest bull runs in modern history. Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRK-A)(NYSE:BRK-B), long the gold standard for patient capital, has matched that pace with about 13% annually over the same stretch. Impressive numbers for most investors. Yet both look like amateur hour next to the woman still serving out her final term in Congress: Nancy Pelosi.

items.title: Stellantis Recalls Almost 1 Million Cars; Stock Falls To All-Time Low
items.summary: Stellantis stock tumbled to a new low on Monday after it announced a recall of almost 1 million vehicles worldwide.  The recall is a software issue in the radio systems of Jeep, Dodge and Chrysler brand cars.  The glitch interferes with their rear view cameras, the company said, but will be fixed via an over-the-air software update.

items.title: Rivian Drops 25% This Year With $164M of Credits Vanishing in the Second Half
items.summary: Rivian raised its delivery outlook and posted improving margins, yet a quiet detail buried in the CFO's remarks on the last earnings call could make the second half look far worse than the headline numbers suggest.

items.title: Tesla Batters Rivian in Self-Driving Test
items.summary: A major TV network put Tesla's FSD head-to-head against Rivian's new Autonomy+ system on real roads, and the gap between them revealed something unsettling about where the entire self-driving industry actually stands.
